name: GAVRIL
source:
You wake up to a loud crash downstairs. 

Sounds like something broke. If you could blame this on a pet or a sibling, that would be great and you could go right back to sleep.   
 
Unfortunately, you live entirely alone. You have no choice but to check it out.

A short horror VN that's more satirical than scary. Your goal is to survive an encounter with a home intruder with characteristics beyond your comprehension.

[from [url=https://partulla.itch.io/gavril]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被楼下一声巨响吵醒。

听起来好像有什么东西坏了。如果你可以把这归咎于宠物或兄弟姐妹，那就太好了，你可以马上回去睡觉。
 
不幸的是，你完全独自生活。你别无选择，只能去检查一下。

一部恐怖短篇VN，讽刺多于恐怖。你的目标是在遇到具有超出你理解能力的家庭入侵者时幸存下来。

[来自[url=https://partulla.itch.io/gavril]Itch.io[/url]]
